verdict: The demo's SNAPFLAG_NOT_ACTIVE snapshots are those retail jamp.exe 1.01 writes for a loading client, and fnTech3's playback skips them as retail's does. The earlier no-3D-view readings were taken after the demo ended. No engine code changed.

server.writer: fnTech3 dedicated server sv_autoRecordDemos, 2026-10-02, OpenJK client peer on mp/ffa1
server.firstActiveRecordCommands: cs 822-834, cs 1131 and 'spc' (opens the player-configuration menu)

observations.fact: flags start from svs.snapFlagServerBit [0x00c317c8]; +1 if rate delayed; at 0x00460c93 +2 (SNAPFLAG_NOT_ACTIVE) when client->state != CS_ACTIVE (4)
a non-active client's snapshot has no delta base
while cls.state [0x008af100] is CA_PRIMED (7) and a demo plays, reads one demo message per frame (0x0041cf00), then calls CL_FirstSnapshot on new snapshots
returns while cl.snap.snapFlags [0x009770d8] & 2; otherwise sets cls.state to CA_ACTIVE (8) and runs activeAction
refuses before cls.state == CA_ACTIVE (8): 'You must be in a level to record'; retail has no server-side recorder
calls the UI's export 7 (set active menu) with the menu argument, no demo-playback check

fntech3Source.writer: code/server/sv_snapshot.cpp SV_WriteSnapshotToClient: snapFlags |= SNAPFLAG_NOT_ACTIVE when client->state != CS_ACTIVE
fntech3Source.playback: code/client/cl_cgame.cpp CL_FirstSnapshot returns on SNAPFLAG_NOT_ACTIVE; CL_SetCGameTime reads one demo message per primed frame
fntech3Source.recorder: code/server/sv_client.cpp SV_StartDemoRecord at gamestate (CS_PRIMED); SV_RecordDemoMessage writes every snapshot message
